title: Jump Game
prompt: You are given an array `nums` where `nums[i]` is the maximum jump length from index `i`. Starting at index 0, return `True` if you can reach the last index, otherwise `False`.
hints: Greedy works here — track the farthest index you can reach so far as you scan left to right.
If your current index ever exceeds the farthest reachable index, you're stuck.
You don't need to try every path — just keep extending the reachable frontier.
